scientific_reason: The empirical outcome compares the actual topology against matched null topologies. The mechanism moderator should use the same contrast rather than actual-topology heterogeneity alone. This refinement is response-independent and frozen before any bird header or response access.

topology_residual_per_graph.H_gi: population variance_j(q_gij) / mean_j(q_gij)^2 across the six fixed pilot possible sources
topology_residual_per_graph.lambda: the actual-graph frozen kernel scale for the actual and every null graph

actual_minus_null_moderator.delta_H_i: H_actual_i - mean_k(H_null_k_i) over the twenty frozen null graphs
actual_minus_null_moderator.n_six_rule: scarcity factor is zero; exclude from primary species universe
actual_minus_null_moderator.primary_standardization: z-score delta_S_topo over the full target-by-eligible-species confirmatory prediction surface after pilot n is fixed, before confirmatory response

response_free_identifiability.required: delta_H must be nonconstant across targets

pilot_gate.species_rule: retain bird species occupying 1 to 5 of the six frozen pilot islands
pilot_gate.if_failed: STOP before confirmatory response; do not widen n or lower minima

primary_scoring.cell_contrast: D_is = logloss(actual_C,y=1) - mean_k logloss(null_C_k,y=1); negative means actual topology predicts the presence better
primary_scoring.within_block_statistic: OLS slope of D_is on the moderator among presence cells
primary_scoring.block_estimability: at least 3 presence cells and positive moderator variance
primary_scoring.estimand: equal-weight mean across estimable confirmatory-block slopes
primary_scoring.support_rule: point estimate < 0 and 95% bootstrap upper bound < 0
